paper.title: Yang,Meng & Karniadakis (2020/2021), B-PINNs: Bayesian physics-informed neural networks
paper.scope: Teaching adaptation: full11-dimensional BNN/log-diffusivity posterior, hard endpoints, known Gaussian sensor noise and sequential NUTS chains in fixed affine whitened coordinates. No Gaussian posterior approximation. Not original wide BNN, VI or dropout benchmark reproduction.

sources.name: Yang,Meng & Karniadakis (2020/2021), B-PINNs: Bayesian physics-informed neural networks
sources.text: Primary Bayesian PINN paper: noisy forward and inverse PDE problems, Bayesian neural networks, HMC and variational inference. This adaptation uses a tiny full BNN with NUTS,a variant of HMC; it does not reproduce the original wide networks or VI comparisons.

sources.name: Eight retained CPU posterior chains and diagnostics
sources.text: Eleven-dimensional neural-weight/log-diffusivity posterior, known Gaussian observation noise, exact endpoints, low/high paired noise. Fixed invertible Hessian-based coordinate transform is sampling preconditioning,not a Gaussian posterior approximation. Failed and divergent original attempts preserved; final chains have no divergences but observable and weight convergence limitations remain.
